# What this user set up. Two keys answered, two keys still on the default, and
# the answer says which is which.
user {"store":"A","log_sink":"L"}
# expect 1: ok
load
# expect 2: ok store=A/user log_sink=L/user [CFG-P1]
key store
# expect 3: ok value=A from=user [CFG-P1]
key log_service
# expect 4: ok value= from=default [CFG-P1]
noise
# expect 5: ok silent [CFG-T2]
